aboutme.label: About Me
aboutme.question: Hello World, how can I help you change the world?
aboutme.firstp: I had a great learning experience within the junior IT company at UFBA, the great InfoJr, I fell in love with web programming. Today I work as a Fullstack Developer at Chuva Inc., building scalable systems that impact thousands of users in the academic environment.
aboutme.secondp: I mainly work with Angular, React on the front-end and PHP, Laravel and Drupal on the back-end. I have experience with software architecture, optimization and automated testing. I want to bring solutions in an impactful way, so, shall we code?

allProjects.name: RankedLy
allProjects.description: A full-stack platform for curating, ranking, and sharing personalized lists (games, movies, books, and favorites). Features secure authentication via Better-Auth with rate limiting and anti-bot protection, game catalog search integrated with the IGDB API, dynamic cover system with smart 2x2 mosaic, public profiles, and full internationalization (i18n) support.

allProjects.description: Learning with the NLW Return (Rocketseat)! Project mobile, front-end and back-end. A feedback widget that print your screen and send the photo and your comment to an email.
